WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time,
    COALESCE(resource.labels.namespace_name, 'unknown') AS namespace,
    IF(severity IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL','ALERT','EMERGENCY') OR logName LIKE '%stderr%', 1, 0) AS is_error
  FROM `${project}.${dataset}.*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__from)))
    AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__to)))
)
SELECT
  time,
  namespace AS metric,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(is_error), COUNT(1)) * 100 AS value
FROM src
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time,
  COALESCE(resource.labels.namespace_name, 'unknown') AS metric,
  COUNT(1) AS value
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__from)))
  AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__to)))
  AND COALESCE(severity, '') IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL','ALERT','EMERGENCY')
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time

WITH log_lines AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time,
    COALESCE(resource.labels.namespace_name, 'unknown') AS metric,
    COUNT(1) AS value
  FROM `${project}.${dataset}.stdout_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__from)))
    AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__to)))
  GROUP BY time, metric
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time,
    COALESCE(resource.labels.namespace_name, 'unknown') AS metric,
    COUNT(1) AS value
  FROM `${project}.${dataset}.*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__from)))
    AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__to)))
  GROUP BY time, metric
)
SELECT time, metric, SUM(value) AS value
FROM log_lines
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time,
  COALESCE(resource.labels.namespace_name, 'unknown') AS metric,
  COUNT(1) AS value
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__from)))
  AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__to)))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time

WITH latency AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time,
    SAFE_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(textPayload, r'request_time=([0-9.]+)') AS FLOAT64) * 1000 AS latency_ms
  FROM `${project}.${dataset}.stdout_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__from)))
    AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS($__to)))
    AND textPayload LIKE '%request_time=%'
), q AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(latency_ms, 100) AS p
  FROM latency
  WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT time, 'p50 (Median)' AS metric, p[OFFSET(50)] AS value FROM q
UNION ALL
SELECT time, 'p95 (Degraded)' AS metric, p[OFFSET(95)] AS value FROM q
UNION ALL
SELECT time, 'p99 (Outliers)' AS metric, p[OFFSET(99)] AS value FROM q
ORDER BY time
